# *Beta Access, Credits, and Fees*

3.1 *Beta Testing*: Nexefy Mapper is currently in a Beta Testing phase. During this period, the service is made available to users without charge, up to a usage limit of 100 credits. These credits allow you to access certain features or processing operations provided by Nexefy Mapper.

3.2 *No Guarantee of Continued Free Access*: Nexefy Mapper reserves the right to modify the credit system, introduce new pricing models, or otherwise change the availability and pricing of the service once the Beta Testing phase concludes.
